title: Great Rebellion of 1817–1818
text: The Great Rebellion of 1817–1818, also known as the 1818 Uva-Wellassa Rebellion , was the third Kandyan War in the Uva and Wellassa provinces of the former Kingdom of Kandy, which is today the Uva province of Sri Lanka. The rebellion started against the British colonial government under Governor Robert Brownrigg, three years after the Kandyan Convention ceded the Kingdom of Kandy to the British Crown.
